title: Career Story
summary: This note summarizes the owner's career progression from Materials Engineering studies to project management at Otis Elevator Company, highlighting experience managing large portfolios and receiving an award. It also details the motivation for pursuing an MBA to transition into a strategic product management role in the tech space.

key_points.text: Studied Materials Engineering at University of Illinois
Spent four years at Otis Elevator Company progressing through three roles in project management
Managed a $47 million portfolio across 50+ construction projects
Won the PM Excellence Award in 2024
Realized desire to transition from construction into tech operations at scale
Pursuing MBA at Haas with intention to transition into the product management field in the tech space

differences: The description of the portfolio management at Otis mentions managing a '$47 million portfolio across 50+ construction projects' in both excerpts.
